items.tr: We will now begin our work.
Please gather around. We will hold the pre-work safety meeting.
I will share today's work details.
Please check the condition of the machinery and tools before starting work.
If you feel unwell or have any physical issues, please let us know immediately.
Please use only the designated pathways within the work area.
Please proceed with the work in sequence as instructed by the supervisor.
Do not operate any machinery or change settings without authorization.
Never work alone in areas where two-person buddy operations are required.
Please verify the locations of the power switches and emergency stop buttons in advance.
Clear any obstacles around the work area and keep it clean and organized.
Please check if safety devices or protective guards are functioning properly.
Using smartphones and wearing earphones during work is strictly prohibited.
If you detect any hazard, stop work immediately and report it.
Shift handover details must be thoroughly verified by the oncoming workers.
Do not rush high-risk work; please adhere strictly to safety regulations.
Please temporarily pause the work.
All work for today has been completed.
After finishing work, please turn off the machinery and unplug it.
Please return used tools and protective equipment to their designated places.
Danger! Please step back.
To avoid electric shock, do not touch electrical equipment with wet hands.
This is a pinch point hazard zone. Watch your hands and loose clothing.
This is a fall hazard zone. Do not lean against the guardrails.
Watch for falling objects. Always look up and check overhead.
A forklift is approaching. Please stop and verify it is safe.
Crane lifting operations are underway. Do not walk under suspended loads.
Caution, high-temperature equipment! Do not touch the surface to prevent burns.
Caution, rotating parts! Never put your hands inside while the machine is running.
This is a fire hazard area. Smoking and open flames are strictly prohibited.
Toxic gas and suffocation hazard zone. Do not enter confined spaces without authorization.
Caution when handling chemicals! Avoid skin contact and inhalation.
The floor is slippery, so please watch your step to avoid slipping.
When lifting heavy objects, bend your knees to protect your back.
Danger of collapse or tipping. Do not lean against stacked materials.
Do not perform welding or hot work near flammable materials.
Do not look directly at lasers or welding arcs with naked eyes.
Do not expose high-pressure gas cylinders to impact or direct sunlight.
Always check the pressure level when opening or closing valves and piping.
High dust area. Please turn on the ventilation system.
Do not stand in pathways designated for vehicles and heavy equipment.
Do not stack items beyond the designated loading height limit.
Please check and strictly follow safety signs and hazard warnings.
Do not climb using uncertified ladders or unstable platforms.
Hang a 'Do Not Operate - Under Maintenance' sign during machine inspections.
Always fasten your safety helmet chin strap before entering the worksite.
Please wear safety shoes to protect your feet.
Wear a safety harness and secure the safety hook when working at heights.
Wear a dust mask or respirator when working with dust and hazardous substances.
Always wear safety glasses as flying debris may occur.
Please wear earplugs in noisy work areas.
Wearing gloves that can get caught is prohibited when operating rotating machinery.
Wear chemical-resistant rubber gloves and protective clothing when handling chemicals.
Wear a welding face shield and leather gloves during welding work.
Wear cut-resistant gloves when cutting or handling sharp materials.
Inspect your protective equipment daily for any damage or wear.
Replace damaged helmets or protective gear immediately with new ones.
Please wear a reflective vest when working at night or in dark places.
Wear heat-resistant or cold-weather clothing appropriate for the working environment.
Please tie long hair back neatly inside your safety helmet.
Loose workwear or drawstrings can get caught in machinery, so please keep them neat.
Please lower your face shield when performing insulation or grinding work.
Wear insulated gloves and insulated shoes when performing electrical inspections.
Access to the work area is restricted without proper protective equipment.
Clean your protective gear after work and store it in the designated locker.
If the emergency alarm sounds, stop working immediately and evacuate.
Press the emergency stop button to halt the machine immediately.
Fire! Shout 'Fire!' loudly to alert everyone around you.
Cover your nose and mouth with a wet towel or cloth, stay low, and evacuate.
Do not use elevators; please escape using the emergency stairs.
In case of power outage, calmly follow the emergency exit signs.
Locate the fire extinguisher, and pull the safety pin to suppress early-stage fire.
If someone is injured, notify the supervisor immediately.
If the person is unconscious, call emergency services and perform CPR.
If chemicals splash on skin or eyes, flush with the emergency eyewash for at least 15 minutes.
If a gas leak is suspected, do not turn on light switches; open windows to ventilate.
Gather quickly at the designated outdoor assembly point for a head count.
Do not block emergency exits or pathways with stacked items.
In an earthquake, take cover under a sturdy table and protect your head.
If a collapse or falling object hazard occurs, cover your head and flee to a safe place.
In case of electrocution, do not touch the person directly; cut the power source first.
Do not disturb the accident scene; wait for instructions from management.
Please cooperate with the instructions of emergency medical technicians and firefighters.
Always be aware of the location of the onsite first aid kit.
Please participate actively in emergency evacuation drills.
We will now take a 15-minute break.
Put down your work tools and move to the designated break room.
Heatwave warning! Please rest in a cool shade and drink plenty of water.
Cold wave warning! Drink warm beverages and stay warm.
Do not stay near hazard zones or machinery during break times.
It is lunchtime. Please proceed to the cafeteria.
Always wash your hands thoroughly before meals.
After eating, return to the work area at least 10 minutes before work resumes.
Do light stretching before starting work after the break to warm up.
Please keep quiet and tidy up in the break room.
Smoking is strictly permitted only in designated smoking areas.
Drinking alcohol or bringing alcoholic beverages into the workplace is strictly prohibited.
There are 5 minutes left before resuming work. Please get ready.
Prevent heat illness by consuming adequate water and salt.
We will start the afternoon work. Please move to your respective stations.
